input.overview: The shop's monitoring stopped receiving the metrics io-shop sends about its own health. No shopper saw anything wrong. A planned renaming of the shop's network ports changed the name of the port that monitoring collects from, but the monitoring setup still looked for the old name, so it found nothing to collect. The problem has lasted {duration}. Argus estimates the lost takings at {customer_loss}. Nobody was paged, and no on-call incident was linked to this one. Argus chose not to undo the port renaming to test its suspected cause, because the renaming was made on purpose. Instead, Argus opened a proposed fix as a draft. The fix has not been applied, so the incident is not yet resolved.
